scope: Evidence for declared constitutive models, not an automatic admission rule or a requirement for simultaneous measurement of all components. A coupled calculation may test robustness over explicitly declared model choices; observed reference spread is not a universal extrapolation bound.

categories.experimental_conditions: Conditions and observables actually reported; envelopes do not create an independently measured rectangular domain.
categories.constitutive_extrapolation: A declared integrable law or temperature/pressure continuation beyond direct observations, with assumptions exposed.
categories.reference_spread_only: A range covering stated reference discrepancies or coefficient alternatives, not a universal empirical confidence band.
categories.coefficient_unidentified: A parameter or error not identified by the retained evidence; omitted is not measured zero.

application_policy.model_acceptance: No boolean empirical acceptance is inferred from this ledger. Reference overlap is useful evidence but its absence is not by itself a rejection of a declared model.
application_policy.numerical_acceptance: Element/mass/pressure closure and global phase support remain independent numerical requirements.
application_policy.physical_error_assessment: Compare actual source concentrations and phase responses across justified constitutive choices and reference widths. Identify unresolved coefficients separately; do not require simultaneous observation of every species as an automatic prerequisite.
